issue_request: FHIR-23867 requested clarification that a complex extension definition is identified by constraining value[x] to 0..0 and defining at least one nested extension.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by 12a292220bb95af891f160d4ec59147f262153a0, merged by PR #2224, which added simple-versus-complex extension language to source/extensibility.html for R5. The exact ElementDefinition authoring guidance for value[x] and Extension.extension is present in source/defining-extensions.html, with earlier history adding those bullets.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps Extension to the extensibility type page, confirming the relevant narrative source is active. Current source/extensibility.html distinguishes simple and complex extensions and links to extension definitions; source/defining-extensions.html gives the precise StructureDefinition rules requested by the issue. FHIR-I minutes for 2019-11-25 record the same accepted motion, and no conflicting Zulip or additional Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source already conveys the accepted rule. Duplicating the exact field bullets on the landing page would not change implementer understanding and would add maintenance drift.
